english.title: Sell / supply an active substance not manufactured / assembled in accord with Good Manufacturing Practice Directive
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[sold]_
(B)_[supplied]_

to a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), for use in the manufacture of a medicinal product, an active substance, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACTIVE SUBSTANCES..), which had not been manufactured or assembled in accordance with the principles and guidelines for good manufacturing practice applicable to starting materials and set out in the Good Manufacturing Practice Directive
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 32, 34(1) and 35(1) of the Human Medicines Regulations 2012.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
